units.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for TypeScript is a free, open-source TypeScript library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx (Office Open XML / SpreadsheetML) workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel. It exposes an Aspose.Cells-compatible API surface — Workbook, Worksheet, Cell, Style — and additionally reads and writes .html, and exports to CSV, JSON, and Markdown for reporting and data-interchange scenarios.
It reads Excel workbooks from disk using Workbook.load, which auto-detects .html files, and writes them back with Workbook.save.
It sets cell values, formulas, and shared strings via Cell.putValue, Cell.setFormula, and Cell.setSharedStrings.
It applies font, fill, border, alignment, and number formats to cells using Style, Font, Fill, Border, and Alignment objects.
It configures worksheet layout by setting column widths, row heights, merged cells, auto filters, and hidden rows through Worksheet methods.
It adds data validation areas and applies conditional formatting rules including color scale, data bar, and icon set rules.
It inserts hyperlinks and comments into worksheets using Worksheet.addHyperlink, Worksheet.addComment, HyperlinkCollection.add, and CommentCollection.add.
It exports workbook data as text using Workbook.toCsv, Workbook.toJson, and Workbook.toMarkdown.
It imports .html files into a workbook via Workbook.load and exports a styled HTML document using Workbook.toHtml.

Aspose.Cells FOSS for TypeScript provides a real class surface centered on Workbook, Worksheet, Cell, and Style — Workbook.worksheets is a WorksheetCollection of Worksheet objects, each exposing a Cells collection for reading and writing values, formulas, and styles.

The Workbook class serves as the main entry point, supporting loading from files via Workbook.load, saving to disk via Workbook.save, and exporting to multiple formats including HTML, CSV, JSON, and Markdown through Workbook.toHtml, Workbook.toCsv, Workbook.toJson, and Workbook.toMarkdown respectively; it exposes its collection of worksheets via Workbook.worksheets.

Each Worksheet represents a single sheet in a workbook, identified by its name via Worksheet.name, and provides access to its cells through Worksheet.cells; cells can be retrieved using Worksheet.getCell, Worksheet.getCell2, or Worksheet.getCellByRef, values can be written with Worksheet.putValue, and cell styles can be applied using Worksheet.setCellStyle.

A Cell represents an individual cell in a worksheet, exposing its content via Cell.value and Cell.formula, supporting hyperlinks via Cell.hyperlink, and allowing programmatic updates through Cell.putValue and Cell.setFormula; its formatting is managed via Cell.style.

The Style class enables formatting control through its constructor, exposing properties for font via Style.font, fill via Style.fill, border via Style.border, alignment via Style.alignment, number format via Style.numberFormat, and protection via Style.protection.

Aspose.Cells FOSS for TypeScript reads and writes Excel files in the XLSX format and exports worksheet data to text-based formats including CSV, JSON, and Markdown. It provides methods such as Workbook.toCsv, Workbook.toJson, and Workbook.toMarkdown to convert workbook content into string representations.

Text export is available as a returned string, not as a direct file-write helper — pass the result of Workbook.toCsv, Workbook.toJson, or Workbook.toMarkdown to your own file-writing code, and text export is one-way — there is no corresponding import path back into a Workbook.

Alignment represents the alignment settings for cell content.
AutoFilter provides filtering capabilities for a range of cells in a worksheet.
Border represents the border formatting of a cell or range.
BorderLine defines the style and color of a border line.
Cell represents a single cell in a worksheet.
CellCoordinates specifies the row and column position of a cell.
CellRange defines a rectangular range of cells.
CellValue holds the data stored in a cell.
Cells is a collection of Cell objects in a worksheet.
ColorScaleRule applies a color scale conditional formatting to a range.
Comment represents a comment attached to a cell.
CommentCollection contains all comments in a worksheet.
ConditionalFormat applies conditional formatting rules to a range.
ConditionalFormatCollection holds all conditional formatting rules for a worksheet.
ConditionalFormatRule defines a single conditional formatting rule.
DataBarRule applies a data bar conditional formatting to a range.
DataValidation enforces input restrictions on a cell or range.
DataValidationCollection contains all data validation rules in a worksheet.
EncryptionType specifies the encryption algorithm used for a workbook.
Fill defines the background fill formatting for a cell.
FilterColumn represents a filtered column in an AutoFilter range.
Font specifies the font properties for cell text.
Hyperlink represents a hyperlink attached to a cell.
HyperlinkCollection contains all hyperlinks in a worksheet.
IconSetRule applies an icon set conditional formatting to a range.
Protection specifies the protection settings for a cell.
SaveFormat indicates the file format used when saving a workbook.
Style defines the formatting attributes applied to a cell.
Workbook represents an Excel workbook and provides access to its worksheets.
Worksheet represents a single worksheet within a workbook.
WorksheetCollection contains all worksheets in a workbook.
